question: Which religion has the majority population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hinduism**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hinduism** is the religion with the majority population in India.
 
• According to the 2011 Census, approximately **79.8% of India's population** practices Hinduism.
 
• Hinduism is considered one of the oldest religions in the world and is characterized by a variety of beliefs, practices, and rituals.
